title: Brand Kit
description: Single source of truth for one brand. Feeds the brand-board template (template-spec.md), the board PDF/PNG, and all downstream generation steps. Everything brand-specific lives here; everything layout-specific lives in the template spec. Canonical output: /creative-brief/<ASIN>/brand-kit.json (optionally also a BRAND.md companion).

asin.description: Amazon ASIN this kit belongs to, e.g. 'B07XJ8C8F5'. Keys the output folder /creative-brief/<ASIN>/.

status.description: DRAFT while gathering, CONFIRMED <date> once the owner has locked it against the rendered preview, or 'stub' for an incomplete starter kit.

name.description: Brand name as rendered in the wordmark, e.g. 'Verdant Grove' (lowercase if the logo is lowercase)

casing.description: How the name is cased in the wordmark

tagline_or_suffix.description: Secondary line under wordmark, e.g. 'LONDON'. Empty if none.

category.description: Product category, e.g. 'cold-pressed argan hair oil'

mood.description: 3-6 adjectives that steer every generation, e.g. ['botanical', 'warm', 'premium', 'calm']

audience.description: Who the brand is for. Drives voice and the moodboard, e.g. 'women 28-45 with textured/dry hair seeking clean, salon-grade care'

voice.description: How the brand speaks. Drives the board's Voice & Tone section and all downstream copy.

sounds_like.description: Short example lines the brand WOULD say, e.g. 'Built for real hair, not a lab fantasy.'

never_sounds_like.description: Phrasings the brand would NEVER use, e.g. 'Miracle cure!', 'Beats every salon brand'

claims.description: What the brand may and may not say. Drives the board's Claims section.

required.description: Claims that should appear, e.g. 'Cruelty-free', 'Cold-pressed argan oil'

forbidden.description: Claims to avoid, e.g. 'medical / treats conditions', 'superlatives (best, #1)', 'competitor comparisons'

disclaimers.description: Required fine print, e.g. 'Results vary. For external use only.'

style.description: Wordmark description, e.g. 'serif wordmark with a hand-drawn leaf ligature on the V'

monogram.description: Monogram/icon description if one exists, e.g. 'gold leaf mark in a circle'. Empty if wordmark-only.

prefers_dark_bg.description: true only if primary logo is light/metallic and needs a dark header band

asset.description: Real file path to the supplied logo image, placed directly on the board. Empty/null if no logo image exists yet.

status.description: FINAL when a real logo image is placed; PLACEHOLDER while the board uses a typeset stand-in.

fonts.description: Two roles: SPECIAL (display/headings) and MAIN (body). Each is a structured object, not a bare string.

palette.description: Exactly 5 hex colors, uppercase #RRGGBB, ordered light to dark (luminance order, NOT semantic roles).

accent_primary.description: Which slot is the hero accent (used for logo-variation block 1), e.g. 'slot3'

hero.description: Prompt brief for the studio product shot

lifestyle.description: Prompt brief for the person-using-product shot

context.description: Prompt brief for the environment/world shot

closeup.description: Prompt brief for the macro product-in-use shot

grading.description: Shared color-grade note applied to all four, e.g. 'warm earth tones, brand accents visible in frame'

motif.description: Pattern description tied to the product, e.g. 'fine line-drawn argan-leaf lattice'

tonality.description: Background tonality. The two patterns MUST be opposite.

imagery_direction.description: Photo direction drawn from the real product photos. Complements the AI moodboard grid.

lean_in.description: Visual qualities to favor, e.g. 'natural light', 'warm earth tones', 'real hair texture'

avoid.description: Visual qualities to stay away from, e.g. 'clinical white labs', 'neon / oversaturation', 'visible text in frame'

role.description: display for SPECIAL, body for MAIN

caps_only.description: true for caps-only display faces; the specimen drops the lowercase row

google.description: How to pull the font from Google Fonts, when available.

available.description: true if the family is on Google Fonts and can be fetched from the name

file.description: Path to the supplied font file when one was uploaded, else null

license.description: License note, e.g. 'OFL (commercial-safe)'. Flag any non-commercial-only license to the owner.
